next_question.rationale: The top gap (created -> confirmed) is large: lost 417,569 (share_of_prev 0.6452). The provided reason clusters only account for part of that loss: user_total 199,417 + artifact_total 42,107 = 241,524, leaving ~176,045 losses unallocated. The abandon_reason drill shows fragments: "user abandon the cart" 111,993; "user clicked back" 83,517; "address changed" 35,111; "add items" 6,996; "items unavailable" 3,907, and was marked distribution_only. Cut by price_band next to see whether the remaining/total loss concentrates in higher price bands (which would point to price sensitivity) versus being spread evenly (which would point toward UX/flow issues or category effects). If price_band shows concentration, confirm via an A/B experiment offering targeted discounts or price messaging to that band.
